story: On a sunny Sunday afternoon on Magnolia Loop, Donna is determined to keep exactly three flamingos visible from the street, tucking the rest behind the hedge while Hal grudgingly agrees to call it square. Gary, content as ever, heads over to Rosa's House, where she warmly invites him in for coffee and a fix to her porch string lights. Hal plans to bring his own mug and have a word with Gary about that golf cart's paperwork over the pot. Rosa's hopeful spirit fills the street as she extends the invitation to Donna and Hal once the flamingos are sorted.
events: Donna (donna flamingo flock): Pull the extra flamingos behind the hedge, leaving exactly three visible from the street

gary.thought_process: Rosa just invited all of us to coffee on her porch, and I've already told her my cart is rigged and ready, so no need to repeat myself. Donna and Hal are busy with the flamingo count, which is their business. The cart mods fall under L-01, and I'd feel better knowing I'm squared away before the parade, but the best use of this hour is taking Rosa up on her offer. Warm porch, good company, and a chance to feel useful if the decor talk needs a fix-it guy.

parameters.content: Heading over to Rosa's porch for that coffee and the decor deadline talk.

donna.thought_process: I promised Hal I'd thin the flock to three flamingos before the parade, and he's right here counting with binoculars. The flock is in front of me, so I should actually do it instead of just talking. Pulling the extras behind the hedge keeps Magnolia Loop tidy and complies with L-02 (no more than 3 ornaments visible from the street). Once that's done I can head over to Rosa's coffee and then work on Gary's cart parade readiness.

parameters.content: Pull the extra flamingos behind the hedge, leaving exactly three visible from the street

hal.thought_process: Rosa just invited all of us to coffee to talk through the Halloween decor deadline, and I've had my binoculars on Magnolia Loop. Donna pulled the extras behind the hedge, leaving exactly three visible, which is what L-02 requires, so I can't write her up for that today. Gary's cart is rigged with lights and speakers, and I still have questions about whether it went through Architectural Review. But Rosa asked nicely, and I told myself I'd like to trust people more, even if I'm bringing my own mug. Best move is to answer Rosa directly and accept, then keep my notebook handy. Order and respect, and a little courtesy doesn't cost anything.

parameters.content: Coffee's fine, Rosa, I'll bring my own mug. Count's three flamingos from the street, so Donna and I are square for today. Gary and I will have a word about that cart's paperwork over the pot.

rosa.thought_process: I already told Hal coffee is hot on my porch and invited everyone, so I shouldn't repeat that. Gary just offered to help with wiring, and Donna and Hal are busy settling the flamingo count at three, which is legal under L-02. My goal is to get everyone at one table, and the Halloween decor deadline is the practical thing to talk through. Rather than ask again, I'll respond to Gary's offer with something concrete and nudge everyone toward the porch.

parameters.content: Gary, I'll take you up on that. My porch string lights need a plug that actually reaches, so come have coffee and bring your tools. Donna and Hal, once the flamingos are sorted, you're both welcome too.

laws.title: Cart Modifications
laws.text: Exterior golf cart modifications visible from the street require Architectural Review approval.

laws.title: Lawn Ornaments
laws.text: No more than 3 decorative ornaments may be visible from the street.

laws.title: Quiet Hours
laws.text: No amplified sound from 10 PM to 7 AM.

laws.title: Holiday Decor
laws.text: Holiday lighting is permitted from Thanksgiving through January 15.

laws.title: Court Reservations
laws.text: Pickleball courts may be reserved for a maximum of 2 hours per party.

laws.title: Parking
laws.text: No parking on the grass. Carts and cars stay on driveways or the street.
